text:
Maya: Quick preflight — planning to ship the micro-briefs change (service: rn-slate) on 2026-03-23 at 02:00 UTC. Draft RN is here: https://internal/redwood/rn/microbrief-2026-03-23.md. Canary first in EU then global. Need pin owner for model/version (v2.3.1-quant) and rollback owner.

Jon: I can own the pinning. I'll update deploy config and pin to v2.3.1-quant. Will stage the image by 01:30 UTC.

Priya: Ops note: recommend 15m canary in eu-west (eu-west-1) then expand. Please set auto-rollout to disabled if error_rate > 2%. Also I'll prepare the fallback policy to v2.2.9.

Sam: Oncall — I'll watch p95/p99 and 5xxs. Can someone paste the deploybot command so I can set smoke checks? :eyes: 

DeployBot: deploybot: queued rn-slate image v2.3.1-quant -> staging. Use:
```
/deploy rn-slate --image v2.3.1-quant --env=prod --canary=15m --pin=true
```

Maya: Thanks. RN needs two small edits before blast: add explicit rollback instructions and contact list, and call out the token-cost delta (+0.8 tokens/op).

Jon: Adding rollback snippet to RN and ops notes:
```
# rollback
/deploy rn-slate --image v2.2.9 --env=prod --force --reason="rollback: perf regress"
```

Priya: Ops trigger conditions: if canary error_rate > 2% OR p95 latency increases by >30% vs baseline, run rollback. I'll author ops-runbooks/rn-slate-canary.md and link it from the RN.

Sam: Can we add a quick smoke test: GET /_health and run a small generation prompt "smoke test" asserting tokens < 120 and response time < 400ms? I'll wire it into the deploy pipeline.

Liam: I'll proofread the internal blurb and run it by legal if the wording touches SLA or customer-impact phrasing.

Maya: Final coordination: post internal announcements to #eng and #customer-success 10 minutes after deploy (02:10 UTC). Who will post? 

Priya: I'll post to #eng.

Sam: I'll post to #customer-success and include the canary metrics snapshot. :thumbsup: 

Jon: Deploy window looks clear on infra side. I'll queue the deconflict job at 01:50 UTC and kick the rollout at 02:00 UTC.

DeployBot: deploy started at 1742245000 (status: canary running) — https://deployboard/redwood/1742245000

Sam: First 5m — small uptick in p95 (+12%), watching. No 5xxs so far.

Priya: Error rate sitting at 0.6% during canary. Keeping the auto-fallback rule ready.

Sam: Canary holding steady — marking watch for next 10m.

Jon: Canary green. Expanding rollout to 50% at 02:15 UTC.

DeployBot: rollout to 50% complete at 1742245200 (status: partial). All health checks passed.

Maya: Solid. I'm uploading final internal announce payload to docs/announce-drafts/microbrief-internal.txt and linking the RN.

Liam: Posted a minor copy tweak to the internal blurb (typo + clarification on impact).

Sam: Can we lock the pin in console now that 50% is healthy?

Jon: Done — pinned v2.3.1-quant to production route in the console. ✅

Priya: Ops final: set automatic fallback to v2.2.9 if errors spike above 3% for 5m. Also enabled alert escalation to oncall.

Maya: Thanks everyone. If anything degrades, run the rollback command above and ping #eng-oncall immediately. I'll hold on the external notes until we confirm full rollout at 02:30 UTC. :handshake: 

Sam: Noted. Will post a short canary summary at 02:20 UTC in this thread and in #eng.

DeployBot: deploy completed at 1742245290 (status: success, rollout 100%). Summary: canary 15m eu-west -> staggered expansion -> 100% complete.

Maya: Awesome — great work team. Final reminder: update the cost line in customer-facing copy before external blast.

Jon: Will follow up with a short PR to the RN to add the cost line and the rollback excerpt.

Priya: Closing runbook drafts and tagging owners. :white_check_mark: 

Sam: Posting summary now.
